source_request: Build me a beautiful website for selling sneakers
assumptions: Brand name, product catalog, policies and imagery must be confirmed or kept editable; Stride Supply is a sample brand.
All product cards, pricing, stock and collection views must bind to real Storelib data.
Newsletter and contact forms only activate when their real integrations are supported.
Cart is intentionally NOT assumed; use configured buy-now / checkout where available.

creative_direction.label: Independent editorial streetwear
creative_direction.type: bold grotesk display + readable neutral body, subject to available fonts
creative_direction.image_direction: large honest product photography, outdoor concrete/city lifestyle detail, deliberate close crops
creative_direction.layout: offset editorial rhythm with restrained high-contrast structure
creative_direction.motion: subtle product hover and scroll reveal, respect reduced motion

global_components.header: responsive category-aware navigation, logo, search only if supported, persistent shop link
global_components.footer: collections, about, contact, FAQ, merchant-configured legal/policy links

commerce_requirements: enabled checkout or honest disabled state
